paragraph: In the last twelve months, [Angola's Justice Minister said in July 2026 that the Bilhete de Identidade results from integrating birth-record data](<https://angop.ao/noticias/politica/impressao-do-bi-abrange-todas-as-provincias-do-pais/>). The two computer systems are interoperable, he said. [In April 2026 Aristides Marques, national director of Identification, Registries and Notary, said a death registered at the conservatória is sent to the database](<https://novojornal.co.ao/politica/detalhe/a-nossa-medida-visa-esclarecer-que-o-cidadao-deve-ter-o-bi-e-nao-e-so-a-pensar-na-questao-da-morte-aristides-marques-director-nacional-de-identificacao-registos-e-notariado-70892.html>) to deregister the citizen. [In March 2026 Mbanza Kongo began registering newborns at a maternity post](<https://angop.ao/noticias/politica/zaire-mbanza-kongo-inicia-registo-de-recem-nascidos-a-partir-da-maternidade/>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for records exchanged, numbers retired on death or records reconciled. Mature would need such a figure from a source of the past three years.

In the last twelve months, [Burundi's territorial administration directorate said in August 2026 that civil registration is to be integrated with the national digital ID](<https://www.rtnb.bi/?mypost%3Fid=596>). [The interior ministry presented one platform for civil records and the new biometric ID card on 6 May 2026](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/burundi-launches-digital-civil-registry-and-biometric-id-initiative>). [Burundi's own presentation says the two systems are not yet fully interoperable](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-burundi_crvs_transformation_journey.pdf>). [Under the ID for D plan of July 2024, births at health facilities are to feed a unique ID number](<https://mininterinfos.gov.bi/vers-une-identification-sure-et-securisee/>). No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[ANIP, the national identification agency, holds both the population register and the civil status file](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T4-1-S2-3-Benin-FINAL.pdf>). Since April 2021 every birth is declared to the register, which issues the child's NPI, and a declared death sets the person's status to deceased in the ID system. In the last twelve months, [ANIP's review of its birth-desk pilot counted 30,160 number updates in the register](<https://www.triomphemag.com/enregistrement-des-naissances-au-benin-le-guichet-unique-de-lanip-fait-bondir-le-taux-de-2195-a-7656-en-six-mois/>). The pilot ran in ten health facilities from 20 August 2025 to 20 February 2026. [In September 2026 ANIP issued 50,109 free birth certificates to children under 14](<https://beninwebtv.com/benin-50-109-enfants-ont-obtenu-gratuitement-leur-acte-de-naissance-en-septembre/>). No national figure for records exchanged has been found; the one held comes from the ten-facility pilot.

[Statistics Botswana says the Births and Deaths Registration System is integrated with the National Identification System](<https://statsbots.org.bw/sites/default/files/publications/Vital%20Statistics%20Report%202024.pdf>). Since 2003 that system has assigned a unique birth registration number to every citizen child at birth. In the last twelve months, [in April 2026 one budget provision of P108,505,050 covered maintenance of both systems](<https://botswanaspeaks.gov.bw/media/COMMITTEE%20OF%20SUPPPLY%20SPEECHES/LABOUR%20AND%20HOME%20AFFAIRS.pdf>). One department, Civil and National Registration, holds both. No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[In November 2025 an article said the Central African Republic plans a national digital identity system, the SNID](<https://ambition-journal.org/fr/economie/systeme-national-d-identite-numerique-moderniser-l-administration>). [The SNID is to unify the country's existing biometric and civil status databases](<https://ambition-journal.org/fr/economie/systeme-national-d-identite-numerique-moderniser-l-administration>). [Implementation of the SNID is set for 2027 to 2032](<https://ambition-journal.org/fr/economie/systeme-national-d-identite-numerique-moderniser-l-administration>). No change to that plan has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[ONECI runs both civil status and identification, and its civil-status server is linked to the register of persons](<https://digitalmag.ci/id-day-2025-lidentite-est-le-parapluie-de-tout-individu-dg-oneci/>), its director general said on 16 September 2025. [Since October 2024 the national identification number is printed on civil status certificates](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/1974954/politique/cni-double-identite-enregistrement-des-naissances-nni-les-clarifications-du-dga-de-lonceci-pelagie-gonto>). In the last twelve months, [ONECI began deploying birth tele-declaration terminals nationally on 11 August 2026](<https://digitalmag.ci/cote-divoire-digitalisation-de-letat-civil-la-tele-declaration-des-naissances-commence-a-man/>). [ONECI reports that 1,291,891 of the 9,323,415 national identification numbers attributed in 2025 were issued via the civil registry](<https://www.koaci.com/article/2026/02/10/cote-divoire/societe/cote-divoire-le-delai-de-delivrance-de-la-carte-nationale-didentite-ramene-a-moins-de-deux-semaines-perspectives-de-la-structure-pour-2026_194217.html>). Nothing found since October 2023 says deaths retire ID numbers. Operating would need deaths to retire ID numbers.

In October 2025 [BUNEC partnered with Liber Technologies to build a digital civil registration system by 2029, integrated with the new biometric ID](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202510/cameroon-partners-with-liber-technologies-to-pursue-crvs-reforms>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, [BUNEC's director general said it was deploying a platform to link civil registration and the national ID system](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202610/cameroons-civil-registration-reform-faces-85m-funding-gap>). [BUNEC's plan for 2025 to 2029 provides for linking the main civil registration centres with identification services](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/etat-civil-le-cameroun-s-inspire-de-la-cote-d-ivoire-pour-interconnecter-ses-donnees>). No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[In August 2024 an ONIP legal expert said civil-status events are reported to ONIP](<https://acp.cd/genre/enregistrement-a-letat-civil-le-renforcement-de-la-communication-recommande-a-la-rdc-2/>). [They are entered in the general population file, the FGP, which they feed](<https://acp.cd/genre/enregistrement-a-letat-civil-le-renforcement-de-la-communication-recommande-a-la-rdc-2/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. No figure has been found for records exchanged between the two. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[Under a November 2024 decree, civil registration officers drawing up a death certificate for a Congolese over 16 must collect the holder's ID card](<https://natlex.ilo.org/dyn/natlex2/natlex2/files/download/117585/COG-117585.pdf>) and pass it to the direction de l'identification civile. [In July 2025 the Interior Ministry was stated to be the guarantor of both identification and civil status](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/digitalisation-de-ladministration-lidentite-numerique-un-pilier-de-la-citoyennete-165865>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[On 25 March 2026 a study under the Amecc project was validated, according to We are Tech](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/les-comores-lancent-la-numerisation-de-leur-etat-civil>). [It creates a Personal Identification Number (NIP) for civil registration](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/les-comores-lancent-la-numerisation-de-leur-etat-civil>). [The study plans interoperability with other state systems](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/les-comores-lancent-la-numerisation-de-leur-etat-civil>). This is the only position found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[In May 2026 Biometric Update reported that Cabo Verde linked its civil registration and national identity systems](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/cabo-verdes-crvs-id-reforms-drive-near-universal-birth-registration>). The link runs through the Autentika interoperability platform. In the last twelve months, [officials at the 2026 ID4Africa assembly cited Cabo Verde as an example of CRVS-ID integration](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202610/can-africas-new-crvs-decade-close-the-death-registration-gap>). They said death registration is high and linked to the integrated systems. No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

In the last twelve months, [the DGPF director said in July 2026 that one directorate handles both the biometric ID card and civil-status records](<https://www.lanation.dj/notre-vision-est-de-faire-de-la-direction-generale-de-la-population-et-de-la-famille-une-administration-entierement-modernisee-interconnectee-et-proche-des-citoyens-abdi-abdillahi-obsie/>). [Birth, marriage and death records are being archived electronically in the national database the DGPF also uses for identity-card enrolment](<https://www.lanation.dj/carte-nationale-didentite-biometrique-dans-les-coulisses-de-la-nouvelle-identite-nationale/>). An integrated identity and civil-status system is the long-term aim. No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

Since 2018, [the interior ministry says, the NIN has been generated automatically from the civil register at birth registration](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-decentralisation-algeria.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the ministry said in May 2026 that its biometric document system is connected to the national civil register and to AFIS](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T2-3-S3-4-Algeria-FINAL.pdf>). The NIN is the key between the databases. [In October 2026 the Interior minister said his ministry holds both the civil register and the issue of identity documents](<https://capdz.dz/archives/21340>). No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[In 2024 CITC gave technical support to restructure databases, integrating the national number project with the civil registration databases](<https://www.citc.com.eg/National%20ID%20SYSTEM.html>). The work covers the birth and death databases. In the last twelve months, [Egypt's CRVS presentation of 2026 said a central births and deaths database operates as an interoperable platform](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-egypt_crvs_transformation_journey.pdf>). The platform includes identity management. No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[In March 2025 Fayda registration began in Addis Ababa schools alongside civil registration](<https://www.bbc.com/amharic/articles/c204dl15p96o>). In the last twelve months, [Addis Ababa's new civil registration system was said in December 2025 to share data with the national ID programme](<https://www.amn.gov.et/en/mayor-launches-new-digital-civil-registration-and-residency-service-platform/>). [The ID programme says Fayda is to be issued at every vital event: birth, marriage and death](<https://connect.mosip.io/resources_pdf_2026/Inclusive_Identity_at_Scale_Ethiopia.pdf>). [In 2026 integration talks were under way to deliver Fayda for births, marriages and deaths](<https://connect.mosip.io/resources_pdf_2026/Inclusive_Identity_at_Scale_Ethiopia.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[In June 2025 ANINF and Interior Ministry officials said the Gabon Digital programme plans to interconnect three systems](<https://www.gabonreview.com/identification-legale-et-digitale-le-gabon-enclenche-la-mise-en-oeuvre-de-trois-projets-strategiques/>): the biometric persons register, the digital ID system and the national civil registry centre. In the last twelve months, [the amended Digital Gabon financing agreement took effect on 2 September 2026](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099090226132027563/pdf/P175987-8dfb5a41-ff83-4fc0-a597-c588997e88ba.pdf>). It provides for a civil registry interoperable with, and distinct from, the RBPP ID system. No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[The Ghana Card Number at Birth system, launched in March 2024, joins the systems of three bodies](<https://gna.org.gh/2024/03/dr-bawumia-launches-ghana-card-number-at-birth-to-enhance-public-services/>). They are the Births and Deaths Registry, the Ghana Health Service and the National Identification Authority. The child receives an ID number linked to the mother's identity. In the last twelve months, [in May 2026 the NIA said it would begin registering children aged 0-5](<https://gna.org.gh/2026/05/nia-registers-over-32000-children-in-volta-oti-regions/>). [In October 2026 the NIA's Bedzrah said the system would help deactivate the identity of the dead](<https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/business/NIA-biometric-system-to-tighten-fraud-controls-2055880>) once deaths are registered. No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[In March 2026 ONECI was reported to handle both biometric birth certificates and the biometric national ID card](<https://idtechwire.com/guinea-launches-biometric-birth-certificates-in-sanoyah-in-civil-registry-modernization-push>). [Decree D/2025/052 has the register of persons fed by the civil status register](<https://guineelex.com/decrets-arretes/decret-d-2025-052-prg-cnrd-sgg>). [Decree D/2025/053 keys both registers to one personal identification number](<https://guineelex.com/decrets-arretes/decret-d-2025-053-prg-cnrd-sgg>). In the last twelve months, [ONECI signed a convention with the electoral body in January 2026 on using civil status data](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/01/conakry-la-dge-et-loneci-scellent-une-alliance-pour-un-fichier-electoral-fiable/>). No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[On 22 March 2024 the Ministries of Health and Interior signed an MoU to harmonise and integrate the National Identity System and the eCRVS](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/headlines/health-ministry-signs-mou-with-interior-to-harmonize-nis>). [The MoU provides for unified NIN generation and sharing between them](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/headlines/health-ministry-signs-mou-with-interior-to-harmonize-nis>). [In the 2025 State of the Nation Address President Barrow said ID cards will be integrated with the Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/headlines/govt-to-integrate-id-cards-with-electronic-civil-registration>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[In June 2025 the Justice Minister announced that civil identification and registry services will be digitised](<https://ang.gw/justica-servicos-de-identificacao-civil-registos-e-notariado-serao-digitalizados-e-informatizados/>). [They are to sit under one directorate-general](<https://ang.gw/justica-servicos-de-identificacao-civil-registos-e-notariado-serao-digitalizados-e-informatizados/>). [UNDP financed a workshop supporting the Integrated National Identification System](<https://ang.gw/justica-servicos-de-identificacao-civil-registos-e-notariado-serao-digitalizados-e-informatizados/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[In July 2026 Kenya's Civil Registration Services said the civil register and the National ID system are linked](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-kenya.pdf>). Birth records carry the parents' ID details, and they verify identity when people register for an ID. In the last twelve months, [in May 2026 the Principal Secretary told MPs a hospital e-notification system will pass each birth to Civil Registration Services](<https://nation.africa/kenya/news/inside-new-reforms-to-curb-birth-certificate-fraud-5463104>). [In November 2026 the Immigration Principal Secretary told MPs the number given at birth would become the national ID number at 18](<https://nation.africa/kenya/news/how-kenya-s-digital-birth-registration-system-will-work--5663174>), and that a registered death would remove the record from active identification systems. Both are plans. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[Liberia's National Identification Registry plans to link national ID with civil registration in one NIDCRVS system](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202609/liberia-to-link-national-id-crvs-in-planned-infrastructure-upgrade>). [It rests on a signed $54 million agreement with OeSD International that awaits approval by the legislature](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202609/liberia-to-link-national-id-crvs-in-planned-infrastructure-upgrade>). In the last twelve months, [the concession was signed in April 2026](<https://newrepubliclib.com/concerns-mount-over-nir-us52m-biometric-id-concession-jeopardizing-jobs-data-and-revenue-security/>), and [on 13 October 2026 the House sent it to a joint committee](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/politics/house-begins-review-of-boakai-s-proposed-national-digital-id-overhaul/article_0c964a7e-9e8c-4c1e-9e05-46bfae096890.html>). No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

No stage is set. [In December 2025 Attorney General Al-Siddiq Al-Sour said a review had deleted more than 17,000 national ID numbers that do not exist](<https://libyareview.com/61619/libyan-prosecutors-uncover-large-scale-identity-manipulation/>), after a team compared national ID system data with the civil status registry. That audit is not an exchange of records between the two. No source found since October 2023 says records pass between the civil register and the ID system, or that a link is under way. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a link between the civil register and the ID system to be planned, contracted or piloted, or one body to be made responsible for both.

In the last twelve months, [Lesotho's NICR said in July 2026 that CRVS, identification and passport data are brought together under one roof](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-lesotho.pdf>). [It describes them as one integrated system, with a unique personal identification number issued upon birth registration](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-lesotho.pdf>). [An ID4Africa deck says the NICR implemented a CRVS-based ID system](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P3-S2-4-Lesotho_FINAL.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[A law adopted on 28 May 2026 allows mass birth registration within the national biometric enrolment](<https://www.banquemondiale.org/fr/news/feature/2026/07/01/no-longer-invisible-unlocking-legal-identity-for-millions-in-madagascar>), the World Bank says. In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 a Studia Inc. project had digitised over 10 million civil registration records](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202609/madagascar-strengthens-trust-architecture-for-national-digital-id>), which the report says sped up ID enrolment. [In June 2026 an expert described the digital ID as linked with civil registration](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202606/madagascar-completes-2-6m-digital-id-enrollments-in-two-months>). No source found since October 2023 says records pass between the civil register and the ID system. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[In May 2025 the DNEC said a biometric population file had been built from the civil register](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T2-P1-S2-3-MALI_FINAL.pdf>). It also reported more than 20 million NINA numbers attributed. [In 2025 the Ministry of Territorial Administration gave ANSAEC the mission of building the civil status database](<https://matd.gouv.ml/agence-nationale-de-securisation-des-actes-detat-civil>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[In the 2025 Nacala birth campaign, people could get an identity card on the spot](<https://jornalnoticias.co.mz/destaque/mocambique-reforca-sua-estrategia-de-expansao-do-registo-civil/>), issued from the registrar's data. In the last twelve months, [by March 2026 a QR code on birth certificates was improving data exchange with the ID registry](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099042226205030950/pdf/P172350-ea7be2a4-0727-4372-a851-4df42faaf183.pdf>), the World Bank reports. In May 2026 the digital agency's chairman said [a joint registration process with the identification directorate was still being built](<https://mznews.co.mz/en/atdi-destaca-capacidade-nacional-para-digitalizacao-do-registo-integrado-do-cidadao/>). Nothing found says records pass between the two registers beyond the Nacala campaign. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

In the last twelve months, [the Interior Ministry's report for early 2026 listed the biometric databases' interconnection with civil status as done](<https://dgat.interieur.gov.mr/node/397>). It does not say which records pass, or which way. [One agency, the ANRPTS, handles the population register, civil status, ID cards and passports](<https://www.elmourageb.com/node/25951>), an August 2026 opinion piece says. [It was set up by decree 150/2010](<https://www.elmourageb.com/node/25951>), so one body holds both the civil and the ID functions. No source found since October 2023 says births enrol people in the ID system and deaths retire their numbers. Operating would need births to enrol people in the ID system and deaths to retire their ID numbers.

[The Civil Status Division keeps the civil status database, which generates each citizen's identification number at birth registration](<https://prb.govmu.org/prb/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/csd.pdf>), a 2024 Pay Research Bureau report says. [Regulations of February 2024 end a national identity card's validity at the registration of the holder's death](<https://paps.mnis.govmu.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/29_The-National-IC-Reg-2024-.pdf>). Before the card is perforated, the Head of the Unit must check that the civil identity register records the death. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for records exchanged, numbers retired on death or records reconciled. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives such a figure.

[NRB Secretary Mphatso Sambo told Parliament that between April 2024 and February 2025 NRB integrated electronic birth and death registration systems with the national ID system](<https://times.mw/national-registration-bureau-targets-8000-children-in-2025/>). [The National Registration Bureau's 2025 slides report 3.5 million births registered with unique identifiers and 179,000 deaths recorded with automated flagging in the NRIS](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/PS1-S1-5-Malawi-final.pdf>). [UNDP says the Nzika registration application connects civil registration with national identity management](<https://www.undp.org/malawi/news/undp-hands-over-152-printers-national-registration-bureau-expand-civil-registration>), and has been piloted in 87 locations across five districts. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No figure for records reconciled between the two registers has been found.

In the last twelve months, [Niger's director general of territorial administration announced in September 2026 reforms creating the ANEI, an agency for registering and identifying people](<https://anp.ne/diffa-lancement-de-la-tournee-nationale-de-sensibilisation-sur-la-modernisation-de-letat-civil-et-lidentification/>). [The reforms also create a National Population Register and a National Civil Status Register, with secure interconnection of the systems](<https://anp.ne/diffa-lancement-de-la-tournee-nationale-de-sensibilisation-sur-la-modernisation-de-letat-civil-et-lidentification/>). [In August 2026 officials said the planned National Population Register will be interoperable with the civil-registration system and the biometric ID card](<https://anp.ne/ouverture-a-agadez-dun-atelier-de-sensibilisation-sur-les-reformes-en-matiere-de-letat-civil-et-didentification-des-personnes-au-niger/>). No source found since October 2023 says a link is in service. Establishing would need records to pass one way or for one event, or one body to hold both registers.

[The population commission says it generates a NIN for each child at birth registration](<https://blueprint.ng/birth-registration-npc-introduces-nin-integration-for-newborns-linked-to-mothers/>) and synchronises the data with NIMC. In the last twelve months, [the commission's VitalReg platform, launched in August 2026, connects to NIMC](<https://nigeria24.ng/npc-launches-vitalreg-digital-birth-and-death-registration-platform-across-nigeria/>). [Since November 2025 Lagos's e-Birth platform links a newborn to a NIN where a parent has one](<https://dpi.africa/from-birth-to-nin-how-lagos-is-building-legal-identity-for-every-child/>).
